title: Build & runtime
summary: Validate, package, and run workloads with the project context kept close at hand.

sections.heading: Build consistently
body: Use a repeatable build command and record the inputs needed to reproduce a result.

examples.code:
npm run build
npm run test

sections.heading: Run workloads
body: Separate build validation from runtime configuration so each environment can be inspected clearly.

sections.heading: Observe results
body: Surface build logs, test output, and runtime signals for the people reviewing delivery.
